intro: A chronological spine across the book — Hijri (AH) years as Firishta gives them, with the Common-Era (CE) equivalents. Read at the reader where each moment lands.

events.label: Abistagi (Alptegin) seizes Ghizni from the Samanids
The omrahs elect the slave Subuctagi King of Ghizni
Mahmud ascends the throne of Ghizni
The destruction of the idol of Sumnat
Rise of Ghor; Ghori burns Ghizni, Ghaznavids end
First battle of Tarain — Ghori defeated by Pittu Rai
Second battle of Tarain — Pittu Rai slain
Death of Ghori; Cuttub ul dien Abeik begins the Sultanate of Delhi
Reign of Shumse ul dien Altumsh (Iltutmish)
Reign and fall of the Empress Rizia
Reign of Alla ul dien, 'the Second Alexander'
The Tughlaqs; Muhammad bin Tughlaq the tyrant
Firoz Shah Tughlaq, the great builder
Timur crosses the Sind — END of the first Volume
